source.name: FC Schalke 04: BEUMER Group to become FC Schalke 04's new main partner
source.quote: BEUMER Group will become FC Schalke 04’s new main partner from the 2026/27 season. The deal brings together two partners whose roots and ambitions make them a perfect fit.

source.name: FC Schalke 04: FC Schalke 04 welcomes Blåkläder as its new sleeve partner
source.quote: The partnership will be visible on the sleeves of the first team’s jerseys and training kits.

source.name: Schalke 04 Fanshop (shop.schalke04.de): adidas Heimtrikot 2026/2027
source.note: Kit maker. The club shop's 2026/27 home-shirt product page: adidas logo on the right chest, BEUMER central on the chest, BLÅKLÄDER on the left sleeve. Deal with adidas and 11teamsports runs to 30 June 2031 (club announcement of 7 Oct 2025).
source.quote: Auf der rechten Brust befindet sich das gestickte adidas-Logo in Weiß

summary: adidas home shirt: BEUMER Group on the front, Blåkläder on the left sleeve, nothing on the back or shorts (the club shop's 2026/27 home shirt and shorts pages list only adidas branding besides these). BEUMER is family-owned, Blåkläder is Gustavsson-family-owned, adidas is a listed company; no state owner in any chain.
